HERO.BADGE: High-Performance API Gateway & Security Reverse Proxy
HERO.SUBTITLE_1: NXGuard provides sub-millisecond request inspection via LuaJIT, live threat intelligence synchronized with
HERO.SUBTITLE_3: telemetry analytics, and zero-touch ACME SSL automation.

SCREENSHOTS.TITLE: Intuitive Management & Inspection Interface
SCREENSHOTS.SUBTITLE: Clean, enterprise-grade dashboard designed for complete visibility and rapid policy management.

DASHBOARD.TITLE: Executive Security Dashboard
DASHBOARD.SUBTITLE: Real-time overview of threats, blocked requests, and system health
DASHBOARD.DESCRIPTION: Intuitive management interface with live metrics, transaction counts, WAF alerts, and operational controls.

TRANSACTIONS.TITLE: Transaction Stream & Monitoring
TRANSACTIONS.SUBTITLE: Live transaction logging and traffic inspection
TRANSACTIONS.DESCRIPTION: Search, filter, and inspect incoming requests by service, status, IP, country, and threat score.

RAW_INSPECTION.TITLE: Raw Request & Payload Inspection
RAW_INSPECTION.SUBTITLE: Deep dive into headers, query parameters, and body payloads
RAW_INSPECTION.DESCRIPTION: Complete inspection of raw HTTP transactions to investigate attacks and debug traffic anomalies.

RULE_DETAILS.TITLE: ModSecurity Rule Match Details
RULE_DETAILS.SUBTITLE: Granular rule triggers and matched patterns
RULE_DETAILS.DESCRIPTION: Detailed analysis of matched ModSecurity rule IDs, tags, severity levels, and matched string segments.

ARCHITECTURE.TITLE: Processing Pipeline & Security Flow
ARCHITECTURE.SUBTITLE: Modular pipeline linking network ingress, policy evaluation, and telemetry storage.
ARCHITECTURE.STEP_1_DESC: Traffic arrives on OpenResty worker threads. Custom Lua sensors perform rapid dynamic bypass, geo-filtering, and initial validation before invoking inspection.
ARCHITECTURE.STEP_2_DESC: Comprehensive payload parsing and regex evaluation against OWASP Core Rule Set 4.25+. Granular per-route sensor policies enable dynamic rule tailoring without reloads.
ARCHITECTURE.STEP_3_DESC: Continuous threat intelligence synchronized with IPXA. All audit logs and blocked transactions are saved in embedded DuckDB for instant analytics and reporting.

FEATURES.TITLE: Core Engine Features
FEATURES.SUBTITLE: Engineered for high-throughput APIs and enterprise security compliance.

MODSECURITY.TITLE: Advanced ModSecurity v3 WAF
MODSECURITY.DESCRIPTION: Native integration with ModSecurity v3 and OWASP Core Rule Set 4.25+ protecting against SQLi, XSS, RCE, LFI/RFI, and zero-day vulnerabilities.

LUAJIT.TITLE: High-Performance LuaJIT Core
LUAJIT.DESCRIPTION: Custom Lua sensors running directly inside OpenResty worker threads for rapid request filtering, header sanitization, and rate-limiting.

IPXA.TITLE: IPXA Threat Intelligence
IPXA.DESCRIPTION: Continuous synchronization with IPXA for dynamic IP reputation, real-time threat feed integration, geo-blocking, and smart bypass rules.

DUCKDB.TITLE: DuckDB Embedded Analytics
DUCKDB.DESCRIPTION: Columnar storage engine embedded directly in the admin backend for rapid real-time transaction query, aggregation, and auditing.

ACME.TITLE: ACME & SSL Automation
ACME.DESCRIPTION: Automated certificate issuance and renewal via Let's Encrypt / ACME with HTTP-01 challenges and seamless Nginx reload.

ROUTING.TITLE: Smart Reverse Proxy & Routing
ROUTING.DESCRIPTION: Upstream health checks, session stickiness, HTTP method filtering, allowed content-type validation, and route-specific security policies.

BENCHMARKS.TITLE: Security Validation with GoTestWAF
BENCHMARKS.SUBTITLE: Continuous automated verification against modern attack payloads and OWASP categories.
BENCHMARKS.RUNNER_DESC: Execute the official GoTestWAF container to simulate multi-vector exploits against your ruleset:

QUICKSTART.TITLE: Quick Start with Docker Compose
QUICKSTART.SUBTITLE: Deploy the full stack (NXGuard + IPXA Threat Feed) in seconds.
QUICKSTART.PRIVACY_DESC: NXGuard collects anonymous, aggregated traffic statistics over 24-hour cycles to optimize threat detection models.
QUICKSTART.PRIVACY_STRONG: No sensitive, personal, or request-specific payloads are ever collected.
